rubric.role_summary: Remote telehealth physician supporting U.S. patients, collaborating with healthcare advocates on care plans and helping develop a patient care program.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Remote telehealth physician supporting U.S. patients, collaborating with healthcare advocates on care plans and helping develop a patient care program.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.

location.requirement_text: Location: United States (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
source_quotes: Applicants must be based in the United States.

soft_requirements: Strong clinical and organizational skills, including managing multiple tasks under pressure.
Communication, listening, and empathy in patient interactions.
Comfort working with elderly patients and people facing social determinants of health.
Ability to learn new systems and software quickly.
Bias toward action, willingness to share feedback, and adaptability to change.

interpretation.user_instruction: for multiple locations, accept either one, broaden the area to the general area if it's a specific city, if remote + a location, please force them into the location, follow the text rather than the metadata, for x-y years exp, unbound the top but evaluate obviously overqualified candidates as failures in the final fit eval, other than that, assume the less strict of interpretations (eg masters required versus masters or phd, eval as if masters or phd)

implied_evidence.user_instruction: Change the scoring such that for must-have criteria, it can still score as a pass if this is implied. Change any impossible or largely unstated must haves to preferences rather than must-haves. On the secondary reviewer, we should also score implied experience/competence as a pass. Make these changes to every role.

metro_radius.user_instruction: Make location validation accept nearby metros within 100 miles as correct.

single_location.user_instruction: change all roles on this benchmark location settings for both the post-evaluators and for the role brief: if a role says relocation offered and realistically they'd hire anyone from the us, then eval on this and have it in the brief. There should NEVER be contradictory location filtering in the role (eg sf or remote), evaluated against sf. It should always PICK ONE. Make your best judgment for htis but repair all roles in this way to be 1 location or remote in the role + evaluator.
